items.title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Update Leaves Few Linux Servers Unprotected After Reboot
items.description: A recent Microsoft Defender for Endpoint update briefly disabled antivirus protection on Linux servers following an upgrade and reboot, exposing affected machines to threats before Microsoft rolled out a fix. items.title: GitHub Adds 3-Day Dependabot Cooldown to Block Malicious Package Updates
items.description: GitHub has introduced a default three-day cooldown period for Dependabot version updates to reduce the risk of projects automatically adopting new malicious packages. This change targets a prevalent pattern in software supply chain attacks where attackers compromise a trusted package maintainer’s account, publish a malicious update, and rely on automated dependency tools to distribute it […] The…

The attack requires no account, administrative access, or interaction from another user. items.description: The malware-as-a-service operation launches legitimate browsers on an invisible desktop, giving attackers persistent and covert remote access to compromised Windows systems.
